activePriority.statement: Reach 1,000 verified Zaylist downloads within a 90-day period by proving meaningful adoption in Portland
activePriority.publicUse: Goal may be stated publicly without attribution

acceptedFacts.statement: Zaylist is independently created, built, designed, and directed by Tucker; it is built for and informed by community, not community-built or community-governed
Pride Guide PDX began on Squarespace after a local Pride guide omitted gay events; four annual Pride Guides evolved into year-round Zaylist

A verified adoption event is one server-confirmed successful file download with full delivery confirmation, counted within a 90-day window. No adoption or conversion numbers are reported until this measurement is implemented and verified.

protectedContext.handling: Authorized internal business planning only; public and external outputs use the abstract rule that founder stability is a business-continuity constraint
May be used in authorized internal Zaylist materials labeled INTERNAL / NDA-PROTECTED; never send to external models or public artifacts
Personal details inform care and judgment but require Tucker's explicit approval before any public use

resolvedBlockers.statement: Verified download/adoption lacks an approved technical definition and authoritative measurement source
resolvedBlockers.resolution: Canonical unit is one server-confirmed successful file download with full delivery confirmation, counted within a 90-day window. Measurement implementation is the remaining follow-up.
resolvedBlockers.followUp: Implement and verify the server-confirmed download event before reporting any adoption numbers.

resolvedBlockers.statement: Homepage wordmark asset loads and occupies its box but was visually absent in audited desktop and mobile views
resolvedBlockers.resolution: Confirmed as a bug. Restore the existing wordmark treatment and keep it visible.
resolvedBlockers.followUp: Diagnose the invisibility root cause on the homepage and restore visible rendering against the existing standard.
